question: Within the qualified author aliases and original broad annotations, what mean RNA expression, raw-count detection and cell recovery describe WT/D25K-associated immune readouts?
decision: Describe the observed microglial and T-cell measurement pattern, retaining attenuation, null and opposing marker directions, while distinguishing source holds from supportable finite-pool summaries.
strongest_rival: Pool variation, cell recovery/state composition, unmapped dose/accession labels and downstream exclusion differences can explain apparent ligand contrasts; cells cannot estimate between-mouse variance.
discriminator: Within each explicit WT5/Mut5 and WT1/Mut1 pair, compare mutant-minus-WT and each-minus-old-Control marker means and detection fractions; retain young-Control context, counts, absent markers and Gzmb-positive/all-T denominators. No causal mechanism or age interaction is identified.
exposure_record: EXPOSED description. Paper, animal results, published marker lists and author code were already read. Metadata runs exposed all condition/type counts, eight aliases, normalized samples, QC and command parameters. No unexposed confirmation is claimed.
biological_unit: One observed pool/library per reported condition; cells nested within pool. Extra WT50/Mut50 pool/source identity unresolved.
nesting_and_overlap: Old Control is one reported mouse, other reported main libraries pool two mice, no multiplexing. Both alias pairs reuse the same old Control; Young is reference only. No per-mouse labels or replicated intervention units.
population_and_selection: Original broad Microglia and T_cells in Young, Control, WT5, Mut5, WT1 and Mut1. No reclustering, integration, downsampling, extra QC exclusions or subtype sensitivity. WT50/Mut50 recovered counts retained but expression contrasts held.
contrast: Mut5-WT5, WT5-Control, Mut5-Control, Mut1-WT1, WT1-Control, Mut1-Control; Young-Control context. Aliases primary: main-pair 0.02 mg/mL is figure-linked, other numerical dose unverified.
endpoint: Per marker: mean stored RNA LogNormalize(10000) expression, fraction raw counts > 0, recovered cells. Exact 28 IL10-related mixed-direction and 20 IFN-related vectors; Ifng/Gzmb all-T; Gzmb-positive conditional mean with all-T denominator.
methods: Sparse RNA access; release unused assays after loading. R computes all summaries/contrasts, emits selected nonzero gene/cell entries with complete denominators. Independent Python math.fsum reconstructs every target entry from raw counts/library totals, checks every summary/contrast, and renders four measured SVGs. Zero counts remain denominators; absent genes remain NA. No hallmark score replacement.
missingness_and_exclusions: No new cell exclusions. Broad microglia lack downstream Micro_types exclusions. Gene absence differs from zero expression. Empty groups/subsets retain zero counts and NA means/fractions. Socs3 versus Stat3 code/caption discrepancy retained, both shown individually.
multiplicity: All prespecified marker vectors and seven contrasts reported. No inferential P values, confidence intervals, cell permutations, bootstraps or multiplicity-adjusted significance.
precision_basis: Exact observed finite-pool descriptions only; one pool cannot identify population uncertainty. Old-Control T-cell denominator is nine. Numerical tolerance 1e-10 verifies arithmetic, not scientific precision.
interpretation_limit: No population treatment effect, independent replication, age-by-treatment interaction, mediation, secretion, pathway flux, repair or beneficial-score inference. This is not exact recreation of downstream plots or missing hallmark score.
stop_rule: Stop on input/hash or cell alignment failure, invalid sparse data, independent arithmetic disagreement, or resource limits. Preserve the failed receipt and freeze an amendment for any code/design correction; never drop unfavorable markers to pass.
amendment_reason: Initial frozen EXPOSED pooled RNA description after source/layer qualification; immutable published vectors and all supported alias-pair contrasts.
